name: Kernel Density Estimation (KDE)
aliases: Kernel Density Estimation (KDE) — Parzen Window Estimation, Smooth Point Cloud Representation
definition: Creates a smooth continuous representation of point cloud data to minimize high-frequency noise caused by irregular point spacing and small object sizes.
summary: Kernel Density Estimation transforms discrete point clouds into smooth scalar fields, revealing interior structures obscured by noise and providing volumetric continuity that isosurface and direct point rendering lack.
